title: Introduce usage-driven fingerprinting and compact release heuristics for onboarding
author: Aditi Menon
description:
Motivation: onboarding metadata today relies on static heuristics and manual authoring for release notes. Teams requested compact, data-driven hints so that changelogs and compatibility notes reflect observed production usage rather than purely model architecture. This PR introduces a sampled, usage-driven model fingerprint and a compact release heuristics generator that seeds automated changelog drafts.

What this does (high level): adds a fingerprint extractor that consumes anonymized telemetry samples (seq length distribution, tokenization skew, median latency bucket, typical context window usage, and feature-affordance hits) and emits a compact JSON-friendly fingerprint. The release heuristics module maps fingerprints to short human-friendly impact tags (e.g., "short-context-optim", "latency-sensitive", "embedding-heavy") and a suggested one-line release blurb plus a short checklist for compatibility tests.

Why unique: unlike prior profile work which focused on offline performance sweeps, this ties onboarding metadata directly to observed usage patterns so rollout notes and profiling targets align with customer workloads. The heuristics are intentionally conservative (suggested tests, not prescriptive rollouts) to avoid blocking pipelines.

Design notes: fingerprinting runs as a streaming sampler in the onboarding pipeline: samples are rate-limited (configurable) and only include aggregate counts and histograms; there is no PII or raw text. Fingerprints are stored as a compact base64-stamped blob and a small top-level keyset used by the autodraft engine. The autodraft templates use a small ruleset (configurable YAML) with weighted heuristics to produce 1-2 suggested release bullets and 2-3 impact tags.

Files touched: onboarding pipeline (fingerprint generation), onboarding CLI flag to opt-in/out of telemetry sampling, changelog/autodraft generator, unit tests, and docs.

Testing and validation: added unit tests for the fingerprint extractor and deterministic rules for heuristics; ran an integration test with a sampled internal workload and compared suggested tags against a manual review (80%+ precision for top-1 tag in sample). CI run originally failed formatting on a helper; fixed and reran.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind `onboard.fingerprint.enabled` (false-by-default in prod). We'll enable for a small cohort of internal teams for two weeks, collect feedback, and then flip the flag for broader use.

Checklist: - [x] implement fingerprint extractor and serializer - [x] add CLI opt-in flag and safe defaults - [x] implement compact heuristics engine and template renderer - [x] add unit and integration tests - [x] update docs and quickstart section with examples and privacy notes

Related: references ENG-4212 (usage-driven onboarding) and SUP-1145 (support case requesting better changelog hints).

release_notes: Adds usage-driven fingerprinting for model onboarding and an autodraft release heuristics engine. Seeds automated changelog bullets and impact tags based on sampled production-like telemetry. Feature is opt-in and gated; privacy-first (no raw text captured).
